name: Devil Bout
summary: This is a small game where you play tennis with swords and a bomb for the ball. If the Bomb bounces twice on your opponents side then it explodes and you score a point. The game has a computer Ai and is also playable for 2 people against each other through the same keyboard. player one uses the arrow keys and spacebar, player two uses "a" to swing their bat and "s" "e" "d" "f" to move.
